# Odina seed catalogue — D104. This file is a starting point, not coverage:
# the UI never calls the machine "protected" because this file matched.
# Format: odina-seed/v1, tab separated, one admitted hash per row.
#   sha256 <TAB> size <TAB> family <TAB> licence <TAB> source
# Rules enforced by SeedCatalog::parse (crates/odina-core/src/signature_db.rs):
#   * a row carries a licence we can actually grant — only cc0-1.0 is accepted;
#   * a hash enters only through the D109 admission gates (two independent
#     origins, or a sample verified locally, and a clean-corpus check);
#   * no duplicates, no empty family, no invented hash. A guess here becomes a
#     false positive on someone's machine, so a row is added only when the
#     digest was computed from a file we handled or from a published source.
# Size cap is enforced at packaging time (SEED_MAX_BYTES in signature_db.rs and
# tools/package-windows.py); when the seed would exceed it, rows move to the
# full catalogue instead of growing the installer.
odina-seed/v1
# EICAR anti-malware test file: the canonical, deliberately harmless sample
# every scanner is expected to detect. Including it proves the pipeline end to
# end without shipping a real threat. 68 bytes, verbatim from eicar.org.
